Implementation must be coupled with clear commitments to transparency, agency, and continuous evaluation of the system’s impact.

A3.justification: While I appreciate the compromise reflected in this specification, and agree with many of the stipulations – particularly regarding data sensitivity and prioritizing recall over absolute accuracy – my support hinges on robust external safeguards.
